rooms.name: Gatehouse Portcullis
rooms.desc: A black stone wall studded with spikes closes the road, horned vulture-demons squatting along its top; green fire burns behind the shut iron portcullis in its centre.
rooms.dm: Gatehouse 30 ft high, walls 20 ft. The portcullis rises by itself when anyone comes within 10 ft and drops again after a minute.

rooms.name: Curtain of Green Flame
rooms.desc: Silent green fire hangs like a curtain across the gate's inner arch.
rooms.dm: 6d10 (33) fire on entering it for the first time on a turn or starting a turn in it. Dispel magic DC 16 suppresses it 1 minute; antimagic suppresses it.

rooms.name: Guard Tower, Ground Floor
rooms.desc: An eight-sided room of pale stone. The fireplace opposite the door is dead and the wind whistles in its flue; steps climb along one wall, and three windows show nothing but fog below.
rooms.dm: The ironbound door is barred inside (DC 22 Strength to force). The stair climbs 20 ft to T5. X marks the arrival point for teleports from K78.

rooms.name: Eastern Arch
rooms.desc: The east arch, twin of the west, but one horseman has fallen to pieces and only the back half of his mount remains. Beyond, the road climbs on.
rooms.dm: Two empty 10-ft guard posts. Three miles on the pass forks: north to the Amber Temple, south round Mount Ghakis to the mists.

rooms.name: Eastern Arch, North Guard Post
rooms.desc: An empty guard post under the broken statue, chunks of the fallen knight outside.
rooms.dm: Empty 10-ft-square post; shelter from the roc.

rooms.name: Eastern Arch, South Guard Post
rooms.desc: An empty guard post inside the arch.
rooms.dm: Empty 10-ft-square post; shelter from the roc.

rooms.name: Western Arch
rooms.desc: A tall stone arch marks the bridge's west end; on top, two stone horsemen level their lances at each other. Wind moans through the gorge below.
rooms.dm: Empty guard posts on each side of the road give some shelter from the wind, and from the roc.

rooms.name: Western Arch, North Guard Post
rooms.desc: A cramped stone guard post inside the arch, out of the wind.
rooms.dm: Empty. 10 ft wide; the roc can't reach anyone sheltering here.

rooms.name: Western Arch, South Guard Post
rooms.desc: A cramped stone guard post inside the arch, out of the wind.
rooms.dm: Empty. 10 ft wide; the roc can't reach anyone sheltering here.

rooms.name: Stone Bridge
rooms.desc: The bridge runs narrow and high over the gorge, gaps where its parapets have fallen. Halfway across, a dark rider on a dark horse sits waiting.
rooms.dm: 10 ft wide, 90 ft long, 500 ft above the Luna River; slippery but safe. The rider is Strahd's manifestation: any interaction and it scatters like ash.

objects.label: The portcullis shrieks up on its own when anyone comes within 10 ft, stays up 1 minute, then drops. Flying or climbing over the gate wakes the vrocks on the roof (T2).
Curtain of green flame: entering it or starting a turn in it deals 33 (6d10) fire. Dispel magic (DC 16) suppresses it for 1 minute; an antimagic field suppresses it too.
X: where characters teleporting from K78 in Castle Ravenloft arrive.
Ironbound door, barred from within: DC 22 Strength (Athletics) to force.
Slippery in a few places but safe. 500 ft down to the Luna River, barely seen through the fog. Bloodhorn's Charge and the Roc of Mount Ghakis can strike here.
Empty guard posts; anyone in them is out of the roc's reach.
The road from the Raven River crossroads

The map's contours (+100 to +1,000 ft) measure the mountain from the river; the road runs about level at +500, the tower roof 540 ft above the valley. The road is snowbound: extreme cold at night without cold-weather gear.
Strahd's phantom rider: a grim warning; touched or spoken to, horse and rider scatter like ash
objects.playerLabel: A black-cloaked rider on a charcoal horse

objects.label: Roc of Mount Ghakis (event): dives on parties crossing east to west, snatches a horse or mule if it can, can't reach the guard posts
Sangzor, the Bloodhorn (event): giant goat, 33 hp, resists nonmagical weapons; charges down the slope, a failed save sends the target 100 ft down onto a ledge; flees at 10 damage
objects.playerLabel: A huge grey goat with great horns

rooms.name: Guard Tower, Upper Floor
rooms.desc: Bitter cold up here, and nearly every wall has a window. A rusted ladder climbs to a trapdoor in the ceiling; a dire wolf's head glares down from above the hearth.
rooms.dm: The rusted ladder is bolted to floor and ceiling; the trapdoor squeals open onto the roof.

objects.label: An icebox: wind howls down the chimney. The trapdoor overhead squeals as it opens onto the roof (T6).

rooms.name: Demon Statues
rooms.desc: Two horned, vulture-headed demons carved in stone squat on the gatehouse roof.
rooms.dm: Petrified vrocks: they turn to flesh if attacked or if anyone flies or climbs past the gate, pursue fleeing prey and fight to the death.

objects.label: The two statues are petrified vrocks: they turn to flesh (vrock statistics) if attacked or if anyone flies or climbs past the gate, pursue fleeing prey and fight to the death.

rooms.name: Guard Tower Rooftop
rooms.desc: Snow drifts across a battlemented roof under a grey sky; gilded statues of women knights with lances stand on the merlons, staring outward. Bones in rusted mail lie under the snow.
rooms.dm: 40 ft up, 540 ft above the valley. Four old guards' remains: rags, broken bows and arrows, rusted swords, rusty mail. Card-reading treasure: six snow maidens rise from the snow.

objects.label: Under the snow, four guards' remains: tattered cloth, broken longbows and arrows, rusted blades in ruined sheaths, rusty chain mail
Snow maiden (specter; cold immune, cold Life Drain): only if the card reading puts a treasure here; it appears in the snow when the last falls
